claims.text: Trinity College Dublin says specific uses of GenAI in an assessment must be disclosed, properly acknowledged, and referenced; students should explain what, when, and how they used GenAI.

evidence.quote: To maintain academic integrity when using GenAI in an assessment, the specific uses of GenAI must be disclosed, properly acknowledged and referenced. Students should explain in detail what, when, and how they used GenAI in their assignment.
evidence.title: GenAI and Assessment
evidence.location: Assessment and Academic Integrity / disclosure guidance

claims.text: Trinity Library guidance says GenAI use as a functional tool in academic work must be acknowledged in an Appendix or Methods section, with minimum details including the system name and version, publisher, URL and context of use.

evidence.quote: The use of GenAI must be acknowledged in an Appendix or Methods section of any piece of academic work
evidence.title: Acknowledging & Referencing Gen AI - Generative AI - Library Guides at Trinity College Dublin
evidence.location: Acknowledging the use of generative AI in academic work
